name: reader-companion-devtools
description: Dev-only tooling for readerCompanion: git hooks, formatting and Markdown linting.

scripts.package:linux: dotnet publish src/ReaderCompanion.Desktop -c Release -r linux-x64 --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o artifacts/linux-x64
scripts.package:windows: dotnet publish src/ReaderCompanion.Desktop -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:IncludeNativeLibrariesForSelfExtract=true -o artifacts/win-x64
